about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: The CimcimKids story
about.p1: CimcimKids was founded to offer clothing kids can move freely in and parents can trust. Our mission is to bring together comfort, quality, and simple style.
about.p2: Our collections span from baby to school age. Every piece is carefully chosen with fabrics suited to everyday life and play.
about.p3: Comfort, durability, and customer satisfaction are our core values. Let’s complete little wardrobes together.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to your questions
faq.q1: How should I choose a size?
faq.a1: Each product page includes age/size guidance. If unsure, size up or contact us.
faq.a2: Domestic orders are delivered within 2–5 business days. Track your order on our tracking page.
faq.q3: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a3: We accept credit/debit cards (iyzico, 3D Secure) and bank transfer. Card numbers are never stored on our site.
faq.q4: How should I wash the products?
faq.a4: Most of our products are suitable for a gentle 30°C wash. Please follow the care label on each item.
faq.a5: Yes, just note 'gift wrap' in your order. We offer complimentary gift wrapping.

returns.title: Delivery and Return Conditions
returns.subtitle: How we ship, deliver, and handle returns
returns.s1: Orders in Turkey are dispatched and delivered within 2–5 business days after payment confirmation. Shipping is free. Tracking details are emailed and can also be checked on our tracking page.
returns.s2: You may exercise your right of withdrawal within 14 days of receiving the product.
returns.s3: The product must be unused, in original packaging, and undamaged. Return shipping is paid by the customer for withdrawals; we cover shipping for defective items.
returns.s4: You can cancel your order free of charge before it is shipped. Email info@cimcimkids.com to cancel.
returns.s5: Refunds are processed within 10 business days after return approval: card payments via iyzico to the same card, bank transfers to the IBAN you provide.

privacy.title: Privacy Agreement
privacy.intro: At CimcimKids, we take the security of your personal data seriously.
privacy.s1: Collected data is used only for order processing, account management, customer service, and legal obligations. Details are set out in the KVKK Privacy Notice.
privacy.s2: Card payments are processed by iyzico with 3D Secure; we never store card numbers. Bank-transfer payments use our IBAN only. The site is served over HTTPS (SSL). Our website and database run on Hetzner infrastructure in Germany / the EU (and, where needed, cloud database providers in the EU/EEA), so your data may be processed abroad for hosting purposes.
privacy.s3: Cookies and similar technologies are used to improve site experience and manage sessions; you can control them in browser settings. If you sign in with Google, Google’s own privacy policy also applies.

kvkk.title: Personal Data Protection Notice (KVKK)
kvkk.intro: Under the Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 ("KVKK"), we inform you about how CimcimKids processes your personal data.
kvkk.s1: Data controller: Nuriye Kostak (CimcimKids, sole proprietorship). Didim Tax Office, TIN 1630080944. Address: Akbük Mah. 5932 Cad. Rüyamkent Sitesi No: 7/4 Didim / Aydın. Contact: efruzebendes@hotmail.com — Phone: +90 533 700 73 18
kvkk.s2: Identity data (name, surname), contact data (email, phone, address), order and transaction data (products, amount, order number), account and session data, customer transaction history; and, if you opt in, newsletter subscription data.
kvkk.s3: Receiving and delivering orders, managing payment processes (card payments and bank transfer), membership and account management, customer service and communication, securely operating site infrastructure, fulfilling legal obligations, performance of the distance sales agreement; and, with explicit consent, marketing / newsletter communication.
kvkk.s4title: 4. Transfer of Personal Data and Cross-Border Transfer
kvkk.s4: Your personal data may be transferred to authorized public institutions when legally required, to shipping companies for delivery, to iyzico (İyzi Ödeme ve Elektronik Para Hizmetleri A.Ş.) for card payments, and to technical infrastructure providers we use. Card numbers are not processed or stored on our servers. Our website and database are hosted on servers of Hetzner Online GmbH in Germany / the European Union (and, where needed, cloud database providers in the EU/EEA). Due to this hosting, your personal data is transferred abroad under KVKK Art. 9. Purpose of the transfer: secure website hosting and storage/processing of order and customer data. If you choose Google sign-in, limited data may also be transferred to Google abroad for authentication. Cross-border transfers are carried out with the data subject’s information and explicit consent given at checkout/registration and, to the extent necessary for contract performance, under other applicable KVKK grounds.
kvkk.s5: Your data is collected electronically via the website order form, contact form, account registration / sign-in, newsletter signup, and automated log / security records. Legal bases: KVKK Art. 5/2-c (establishment or performance of a contract), Art. 5/2-ç (legal obligation), Art. 5/2-f (legitimate interest); and for cross-border transfer and marketing communications, explicit consent under KVKK Art. 5/1 and Art. 9.
kvkk.s6: Your personal data is retained for the period required by the processing purpose and applicable legal retention periods (10 years for commercial records), then deleted, destroyed, or anonymized.
kvkk.s7: Under KVKK Art. 11, you have the right to learn whether your data is processed, request information, learn the purpose and whether it is used accordingly, know third parties in Turkey or abroad to whom data is transferred, request correction, request deletion or destruction, and withdraw consent where processing is based on consent.
kvkk.s8: To exercise your rights, send a written request to info@cimcimkids.com. Your requests will be answered free of charge within 30 days at the latest.
